title: Water leak in your home: what to do in the first 10 minutes
pageTitle: Water Leak: What to Do in the First 10 Minutes | AZGS
description: Water leak at home? This practical action plan helps you in the first 10 minutes: shut off the main valve, limit damage, and call the right help.
intro: Discovering a water leak is stressful. Suddenly you see water coming from a wall, ceiling, pipe, or appliance, and you don't know what to do first. The early minutes are crucial for limiting damage. Follow these steps to get the situation under control fast.
